selectedOriginals.caption: White Tower of Thessaloniki
selectedOriginals.inspection: Original2019 view inspected: weathered buff/grey random stone and plaster remnants, small irregular arched windows, horizontal stone cordon, projecting arched corbel gallery under brick battlements, narrower upper turret and integrated axial mast. Not an entirely white painted surface.

additionalInspected.caption: White Tower in Thessaloniki
additionalInspected.inspection: 2015 full daylight exterior inspected for warm stone colour, brick crenellations, arch corbels, deep sparse openings, cordon and relative upper turret proportions. Vegetation and cars excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: The white tower, Thesalloniki, Greece.
additionalInspected.inspection: 2011 upper detail inspected: distinct stone arch voussoirs below projecting brick parapet, thick merlons and thin upper cornice; irregular stone/plaster patches, no regular large windows.

additionalInspected.caption: View from the roof, image from the Museum of the History and Art of Thessaloniki, White Tower, Central Macedonia, Greece
additionalInspected.inspection: Museum roof original inspected: real thick brick crenellations, flat stone-paved terrace and thin metal safety grilles across open embrasures. Freestanding interpretation panels excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Fehér torony, Szaloniki
additionalInspected.inspection: 2006 street-side original inspected: main entry is a narrow pointed/segmental dark opening with large pale pointed relief arch above and smooth surrounding patch; low lintelled window left and smaller arched windows higher. Cars obscure threshold; threshold/tread dimensions remain conservative estimates.

sources.inspection: Primary ODAP/Hellenic Heritage read:33.90m height,21.70m diameter, ground plus six stories; surviving tower formerly enclosed by low octagonal chemise. Current single tower scope excludes demolished enclosure. Operator diameter chosen over tourism page22.70m; map22.9m corbel outline consistent with a21.7m main body.

Official museum architecture search result read; direct fetch403.33.90m height/21.70m diameter, outer and inner cylindrical construction, stone/plaster with partial brick and entirely brick battlements. Not treated as retrieved construction drawings.

Aerial inspected: standalone cylindrical tower inside own former enclosure outline, street/entrance approach east-northeast with steps to sidewalk. Flat upper/annular terraces and thick brick battlements. Roof parallax not ground anchor; square/trees/outer enclosure paving excluded.

scope: Weathered cylindrical stone fortification, sparse recessed openings, arched corbel gallery, brick battlements, smaller upper turret, terrace grilles, own entry and axial mast.
limitations: Original authored medium-fi exterior from inspected local2019/2015/2011/2006 originals and museum roof photograph; no photographic pixels redistributed. Official33.9m/21.7m control overall masonry height/body diameter. Map root~22.9m and upper~12m are contextual corbel/turret controls, not surveys.

Main east-northeast door orientation follows aerial street approach and2006 original; exact opening heights/angular locations, stone distribution, turret windows, parapet proportions, entry threshold and mast fittings remain estimates. Temporary scaffolding, modern signs/interpretation furniture, cars/trees, former outer walls, plaza and interiors excluded.
Independent terrain will remain unchanged; geographic activation requires current contact review and footprint replacement remains disabled.
